name: own-organisation-mailbox-phish
description: A mailbox-quota credential lure that names no brand: the display name is the recipient's own domain followed by a department, sent from an unrelated domain the attacker authenticated themselves. The commonest shape in a recent public phishing corpus, and invisible to every rule keyed on the brand table.
